title: OrbyMon | F4 - Ataques e investigação por IP
description: Ataques recebidos e originados, com filtro por IP público, IP privado CGNAT, IP remoto, porta, protocolo e sentido.

list.name: proto
list.label: Protocolo
list.query: Todos : all,tcp : tcp,udp : udp,icmp : icmp,gre : gre,esp : esp

options.content: **Filtros no topo:** *IP* = IP público (dedicado ou pool CGNAT) **ou** IP privado 100.64.x do assinante; *IP remoto* = quem está do outro lado; *Porta* = porta de serviço (portas efêmeras são gravadas como 0); *Sentido* = recebido (internet → rede) ou originado (rede → internet). Período no relógio do canto superior. Fluxos detalhados ficam **2 dias**; eventos de ataque ficam guardados. Valores são estimativas de NetFlow amostrado 1:2048.

panels.title: Eventos de ataque RECEBIDOS no período

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM orby_attack_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND (${ip:sqlstring}='' OR local_ip=${ip:sqlstring} OR subscriber_ip=${ip:sqlstring}) AND (${direcao:sqlstring}='all' OR direction=${direcao:sqlstring}) AND (${proto:sqlstring}='all' OR protocol=${proto:sqlstring}) AND (${porta:sqlstring}='' OR local_port=${porta:sqlstring} OR remote_port=${porta:sqlstring}) AND direction='in'

panels.title: Eventos de ataque ORIGINADOS no período

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM orby_attack_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND (${ip:sqlstring}='' OR local_ip=${ip:sqlstring} OR subscriber_ip=${ip:sqlstring}) AND (${direcao:sqlstring}='all' OR direction=${direcao:sqlstring}) AND (${proto:sqlstring}='all' OR protocol=${proto:sqlstring}) AND (${porta:sqlstring}='' OR local_port=${porta:sqlstring} OR remote_port=${porta:sqlstring}) AND direction='out'

panels.title: Pico de taxa no filtro (1 min)

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(v),0) AS value FROM (SELECT SUM(bytes)*8/60 AS v FROM orby_flow_minute WHERE source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc) AND (${ip:sqlstring}='' OR local_ip=${ip:sqlstring} OR subscriber_ip=${ip:sqlstring}) AND (${remoto:sqlstring}='' OR remote_ip=${remoto:sqlstring}) AND (${porta:sqlstring}='' OR local_port=${porta:sqlstring} OR remote_port=${porta:sqlstring}) AND (${direcao:sqlstring}='all' OR direction=${direcao:sqlstring}) AND (${proto:sqlstring}='all' OR protocol=${proto:sqlstring}) GROUP BY bucket_utc) t

panels.title: Pico de pacotes/s no filtro (1 min)

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(v),0) AS value FROM (SELECT SUM(packets)/60 AS v FROM orby_flow_minute WHERE source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc) AND (${ip:sqlstring}='' OR local_ip=${ip:sqlstring} OR subscriber_ip=${ip:sqlstring}) AND (${remoto:sqlstring}='' OR remote_ip=${remoto:sqlstring}) AND (${porta:sqlstring}='' OR local_port=${porta:sqlstring} OR remote_port=${porta:sqlstring}) AND (${direcao:sqlstring}='all' OR direction=${direcao:sqlstring}) AND (${proto:sqlstring}='all' OR protocol=${proto:sqlstring}) GROUP BY bucket_utc) t

panels.title: Taxa por sentido e tipo de IP

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(bucket_utc,'1m'),CONCAT(CASE direction WHEN 'in' THEN 'recebido' ELSE 'originado' END,' / ',scope) AS metric,SUM(bytes)*8/60 AS value FROM orby_flow_minute WHERE source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc) AND (${ip:sqlstring}='' OR local_ip=${ip:sqlstring} OR subscriber_ip=${ip:sqlstring}) AND (${remoto:sqlstring}='' OR remote_ip=${remoto:sqlstring}) AND (${porta:sqlstring}='' OR local_port=${porta:sqlstring} OR remote_port=${porta:sqlstring}) AND (${direcao:sqlstring}='all' OR direction=${direcao:sqlstring}) AND (${proto:sqlstring}='all' OR protocol=${proto:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1,direction,scope ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Taxa por interface de borda (trânsito, PTT, CDN, peers)
panels.description: Recebido: interface por onde entrou. Originado: interface por onde saiu para a internet.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(f.bucket_utc,'1m'),CONCAT(CASE direction WHEN 'in' THEN 'recebido' ELSE 'originado' END,' · ',CASE WHEN CASE direction WHEN 'in' THEN f.input_if ELSE f.output_if END=0 THEN 'sem interface (0)' ELSE COALESCE(MAX(im.if_name),CONCAT('ifIndex ',CASE direction WHEN 'in' THEN f.input_if ELSE f.output_if END,' (sem nome)')) END) AS metric,SUM(f.bytes)*8/60 AS value FROM orby_flow_minute AS f LEFT JOIN orby_interface_names AS im ON im.source='huawei' AND im.if_index=CASE direction WHEN 'in' THEN f.input_if ELSE f.output_if END WHERE f.source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(f.bucket_utc) AND (${ip:sqlstring}='' OR local_ip=${ip:sqlstring} OR subscriber_ip=${ip:sqlstring}) AND (${remoto:sqlstring}='' OR remote_ip=${remoto:sqlstring}) AND (${porta:sqlstring}='' OR local_port=${porta:sqlstring} OR remote_port=${porta:sqlstring}) AND (${direcao:sqlstring}='all' OR direction=${direcao:sqlstring}) AND (${proto:sqlstring}='all' OR protocol=${proto:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1,direction,CASE direction WHEN 'in' THEN f.input_if ELSE f.output_if END ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Pacotes/s por sentido, com SYN e porta 0
panels.description: SYN alto em relação ao total sugere SYN flood/varredura; porta 0/fragmentos alto sugere amplificação UDP fragmentada.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(bucket_utc,'1m'),CASE direction WHEN 'in' THEN 'recebido' ELSE 'originado' END AS metric,SUM(packets)/60 AS value FROM orby_flow_minute WHERE source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc) AND (${ip:sqlstring}='' OR local_ip=${ip:sqlstring} OR subscriber_ip=${ip:sqlstring}) AND (${remoto:sqlstring}='' OR remote_ip=${remoto:sqlstring}) AND (${porta:sqlstring}='' OR local_port=${porta:sqlstring} OR remote_port=${porta:sqlstring}) AND (${direcao:sqlstring}='all' OR direction=${direcao:sqlstring}) AND (${proto:sqlstring}='all' OR protocol=${proto:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1,direction UNION ALL SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(bucket_utc,'1m'),CONCAT(CASE direction WHEN 'in' THEN 'recebido' ELSE 'originado' END,' SYN'),SUM(syn_packets)/60 FROM orby_flow_minute WHERE source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc) AND (${ip:sqlstring}='' OR local_ip=${ip:sqlstring} OR subscriber_ip=${ip:sqlstring}) AND (${remoto:sqlstring}='' OR remote_ip=${remoto:sqlstring}) AND (${porta:sqlstring}='' OR local_port=${porta:sqlstring} OR remote_port=${porta:sqlstring}) AND (${direcao:sqlstring}='all' OR direction=${direcao:sqlstring}) AND (${proto:sqlstring}='all' OR protocol=${proto:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1,direction UNION ALL SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(bucket_utc,'1m'),CONCAT(CASE direction WHEN 'in' THEN 'recebido' ELSE 'originado' END,' porta 0/fragmentos'),SUM(zero_port_packets)/60 FROM orby_flow_minute WHERE source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc) AND (${ip:sqlstring}='' OR local_ip=${ip:sqlstring} OR subscriber_ip=${ip:sqlstring}) AND (${remoto:sqlstring}='' OR remote_ip=${remoto:sqlstring}) AND (${porta:sqlstring}='' OR local_port=${porta:sqlstring} OR remote_port=${porta:sqlstring}) AND (${direcao:sqlstring}='all' OR direction=${direcao:sqlstring}) AND (${proto:sqlstring}='all' OR protocol=${proto:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1,direction ORDER BY 1

SELECT event_time AS 'Hora',rule_name AS 'Regra',severity AS 'Severidade',CASE direction WHEN 'in' THEN 'recebido' ELSE 'originado' END AS 'Sentido',scope AS 'Tipo',pool AS 'Pool',local_ip AS 'IP público/local',subscriber_ip AS 'IP assinante',protocol AS 'Proto',local_port AS 'Porta local',remote_port AS 'Porta remota',pps AS 'Pacotes/s',mbps*1000000 AS 'Taxa',remote_ips AS 'IPs remotos',syn_ratio AS 'SYN',CASE WHEN e.input_if=0 THEN 'sem interface (0)' ELSE COALESCE(im.if_name,CONCAT('ifIndex ',e.input_if,' (sem nome)')) END AS 'Entrou por',CASE WHEN e.output_if=0 THEN 'sem interface (0)' ELSE COALESCE(om.if_name,CONCAT('ifIndex ',e.output_if,' (sem nome)')) END AS 'Saiu por' FROM orby_attack_events AS e LEFT JOIN orby_interface_names AS im ON im.source='huawei' AND im.if_index=e.input_if LEFT JOIN orby_interface_names AS om ON om.source='huawei' AND om.if_index=e.output_if WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND (${ip:sqlstring}='' OR local_ip=${ip:sqlstring} OR subscriber_ip=${ip:sqlstring}) AND (${direcao:sqlstring}='all' OR direction=${direcao:sqlstring}) AND (${proto:sqlstring}='all' OR protocol=${proto:sqlstring}) AND (${porta:sqlstring}='' OR local_port=${porta:sqlstring} OR remote_port=${porta:sqlstring}) ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: IPs da rede com maior pico (público, pool ou assinante)

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE direction WHEN 'in' THEN 'recebido' ELSE 'originado' END AS 'Sentido',scope AS 'Tipo',pool AS 'Pool',local_ip AS 'IP público/local',subscriber_ip AS 'IP assinante',MAX(bps) AS 'Pico',MAX(pps) AS 'Pico pacotes/s',SUM(vol) AS 'Volume',MAX(remotos) AS 'IPs remotos (pico)' FROM (SELECT direction,scope,pool,local_ip,subscriber_ip,bucket_utc,SUM(bytes)*8/60 AS bps,SUM(packets)/60 AS pps,SUM(bytes) AS vol,COUNT(DISTINCT remote_ip) AS remotos FROM orby_flow_minute WHERE source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc) AND (${ip:sqlstring}='' OR local_ip=${ip:sqlstring} OR subscriber_ip=${ip:sqlstring}) AND (${remoto:sqlstring}='' OR remote_ip=${remoto:sqlstring}) AND (${porta:sqlstring}='' OR local_port=${porta:sqlstring} OR remote_port=${porta:sqlstring}) AND (${direcao:sqlstring}='all' OR direction=${direcao:sqlstring}) AND (${proto:sqlstring}='all' OR protocol=${proto:sqlstring}) GROUP BY direction,scope,pool,local_ip,subscriber_ip,bucket_utc) t GROUP BY direction,scope,pool,local_ip,subscriber_ip ORDER BY MAX(bps) DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: IPs remotos (quem ataca ou é atacado)

targets.rawSql: SELECT remote_ip AS 'IP remoto',CASE direction WHEN 'in' THEN 'recebido' ELSE 'originado' END AS 'Sentido',protocol AS 'Proto',COUNT(DISTINCT local_ip) AS 'IPs nossos envolvidos',SUM(bytes) AS 'Volume',SUM(packets)/GREATEST(1,$__unixEpochTo()-$__unixEpochFrom()) AS 'Pacotes/s médio' FROM orby_flow_minute WHERE source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc) AND (${ip:sqlstring}='' OR local_ip=${ip:sqlstring} OR subscriber_ip=${ip:sqlstring}) AND (${remoto:sqlstring}='' OR remote_ip=${remoto:sqlstring}) AND (${porta:sqlstring}='' OR local_port=${porta:sqlstring} OR remote_port=${porta:sqlstring}) AND (${direcao:sqlstring}='all' OR direction=${direcao:sqlstring}) AND (${proto:sqlstring}='all' OR protocol=${proto:sqlstring}) GROUP BY remote_ip,direction,protocol ORDER BY SUM(bytes) DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Protocolos e portas de serviço
panels.description: Porta 0 = efêmera (não guardada) ou porta 0 real; a coluna 'Porta 0/frag.' mostra só porta 0 real e fragmentos.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE direction WHEN 'in' THEN 'recebido' ELSE 'originado' END AS 'Sentido',protocol AS 'Proto',local_port AS 'Porta local',remote_port AS 'Porta remota',SUM(bytes) AS 'Volume',SUM(packets)/GREATEST(1,$__unixEpochTo()-$__unixEpochFrom()) AS 'Pacotes/s médio',SUM(zero_port_packets)/GREATEST(1,SUM(packets)) AS 'Porta 0/frag.' FROM orby_flow_minute WHERE source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc) AND (${ip:sqlstring}='' OR local_ip=${ip:sqlstring} OR subscriber_ip=${ip:sqlstring}) AND (${remoto:sqlstring}='' OR remote_ip=${remoto:sqlstring}) AND (${porta:sqlstring}='' OR local_port=${porta:sqlstring} OR remote_port=${porta:sqlstring}) AND (${direcao:sqlstring}='all' OR direction=${direcao:sqlstring}) AND (${proto:sqlstring}='all' OR protocol=${proto:sqlstring}) GROUP BY direction,protocol,local_port,remote_port ORDER BY SUM(bytes) DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: CGNAT: assinantes por trás de cada IP público do pool
panels.description: Depende do log NAT do A10. Fluxos sem mapeamento aparecem sem assinante.

targets.rawSql: SELECT local_ip AS 'IP público (pool)',pool AS 'Pool',subscriber_ip AS 'IP assinante',CASE direction WHEN 'in' THEN 'recebido' ELSE 'originado' END AS 'Sentido',SUM(bytes) AS 'Volume',SUM(packets) AS 'Pacotes' FROM orby_flow_minute WHERE source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc) AND (${ip:sqlstring}='' OR local_ip=${ip:sqlstring} OR subscriber_ip=${ip:sqlstring}) AND (${remoto:sqlstring}='' OR remote_ip=${remoto:sqlstring}) AND (${porta:sqlstring}='' OR local_port=${porta:sqlstring} OR remote_port=${porta:sqlstring}) AND (${direcao:sqlstring}='all' OR direction=${direcao:sqlstring}) AND (${proto:sqlstring}='all' OR protocol=${proto:sqlstring}) AND scope='cgnat_pool' AND subscriber_ip<>'' GROUP BY local_ip,pool,subscriber_ip,direction ORDER BY SUM(bytes) DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: CGNAT: alocações de porta do assinante (log A10, sem amostragem)
panels.description: Sem IP no filtro: os 10 assinantes com mais alocações. Muitas alocações por minuto indicam varredura, flood ou malware.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(bucket_utc,'1m'),inside_ip AS metric,allocs AS value FROM orby_nat_user_minute WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket_utc) AND (${ip:sqlstring}='' OR inside_ip=${ip:sqlstring}) AND (${ip:sqlstring}<>'' OR inside_ip IN (SELECT inside_ip FROM (SELECT inside_ip FROM orby_nat_user_minute WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket_utc) GROUP BY inside_ip ORDER BY SUM(allocs) DESC LIMIT 10) top)) ORDER BY 1
